positions.title: Systems Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Enterprise Automation & Scalability:

 - Spearheaded the development of an industry-leading fleet management system, enhancing operational efficiency.

 - Designed and implemented Kuzu/MOP, a cutting-edge media management and data distribution platform.

API & Cloud Integration:

 - Built enterprise-wide APIs (including Zoom integrations for Meta) to streamline workflows for 100K+ employees, boosting global collaboration and productivity.

 - Optimized real-time data flows across hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, ensuring high availability and performance.

 - DevOps & CI/CD Innovation:

 - Founded and scaled a high-performing DevOps team (64+ engineers/contractors), driving automation and backend scalability.

 - Reduced system deployment times by 18%, saving $63M annually through automation-driven workflows.

Security, Compliance & Networking:

 - Managed secure video/telephony solutions, ensuring compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards.

 - Prevented a regulatory breach by leading a call center retention project for financial services.

Revenue Growth & Cost Savings:

 - Drove $5B+ revenue growth through telephony automation and outreach optimizations.
